steps.name: environment - validate Node/npm and safely persist minimal env
steps.description: Validate node (>=16) and npm/yarn presence and versions. Ensure workspace exists. Export NODE_ENV into current session for subsequent steps. Persist a small /etc/profile.d fragment only when running as root or sudo -n succeeds and only if the file content differs from previously written content; do not overwrite unrelated files. Prefer per-user npm global bin when not root and export into current session. Fail with clear exit codes on version incompatibility.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/samsung-ott-sample-92971-93494/SamsungOTTSampleApplication"
SHPROFILE="/etc/profile.d/node_env.sh"
mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
# Verify node >=16
if ! command -v node >/dev/null; then echo "ERR: node not found" >&2; exit 10; fi
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -v | sed -E 's/^v([0-9]+).*/\1/')
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 16 ]; then echo "ERR: node >=16 required, found $(node -v)" >&2; exit 11; fi
# Verify npm or yarn and versions (warn if npm <7)
if command -v npm >/dev/null; then NPM_V=$(npm --version); NPM_MAJOR=$(echo "$NPM_V" | cut -d. -f1); if [ "$NPM_MAJOR" -lt 7 ]; then echo "WARN: npm version $NPM_V may be incompatible with some modern CRA setups" >&2; fi; elif command -v yarn >/dev/null; then :; else echo "ERR: neither npm nor yarn found" >&2; exit 12; fi
# Determine safe npm global bin: prefer per-user location when not root
if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
  NPM_GLOBAL_BIN="${HOME}/.npm-global/bin"
  mkdir -p "$NPM_GLOBAL_BIN"
  export PATH="$NPM_GLOBAL_BIN:$PATH"
else
  NPM_GLOBAL_BIN=""
fi
# Export NODE_ENV into current session only
export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"
# Persist minimal profile only when safe: either root or sudo non-interactive available
CAN_SUDO=1
if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
  if ! sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then CAN_SUDO=0; fi
fi
if [ "$CAN_SUDO" -eq 1 ]; then
  # compose content without stray tokens
  if [ -n "$NPM_GLOBAL_BIN" ]; then
    SHP_CONTENT="# Auto-generated by env-001 for CRA projects\nif [ -z \"\$NODE_ENV\" ]; then export NODE_ENV=development; fi\nexport PATH=\"$NPM_GLOBAL_BIN:\$PATH\"\n"
  else
    SHP_CONTENT="# Auto-generated by env-001 for CRA projects\nif [ -z \"\$NODE_ENV\" ]; then export NODE_ENV=development; fi\n"
  fi
  # write only if different and safe
  if [ -f "$SHPROFILE" ]; then CUR=$(sudo cat "$SHPROFILE" 2>/dev/null || true); else CUR=""; fi
  if [ "$CUR" != "$SHP_CONTENT" ]; then echo "$SHP_CONTENT" | sudo tee "$SHPROFILE" >/dev/null; sudo chmod 644 "$SHPROFILE" >/dev/null || true; fi
fi
# Validate availability
node --version >/dev/null
if command -v npm >/dev/null; then npm --version >/dev/null; fi
if command -v yarn >/dev/null; then yarn --version >/dev/null; fi

steps.name: scaffolding - create minimal CRA React project (non-interactive)
steps.description: Initialize a minimal Create React App project in the authoritative workspace. Prefer preinstalled create-react-app; otherwise use npx in non-interactive mode. Ensure idempotency by checking for package.json and a react dependency in package.json. Capture scaffold logs for diagnostics and initialize git if missing.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/samsung-ott-sample-92971-93494/SamsungOTTSampleApplication"
cd "$WORKDIR"
LOG=/tmp/scaffold.log
# Idempotency: check package.json with react dependency
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  if node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.react||p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies.react){process.exit(0)} else {process.exit(2)}" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi
fi
# Choose CRA binary
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null; then CRA_CMD=(create-react-app . --use-npm --template cra-template-pwa); else CRA_CMD=(npx --yes create-react-app@latest . --use-npm --template cra-template-pwa); fi
# Run non-interactive scaffold, capture logs
("${CRA_CMD[@]}" > "$LOG" 2>&1) || (sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 20)
# ensure git
[ -d .git ] || git init -q || true
# quick verification: package.json now must declare react
if ! node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(!(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.react)) process.exit(1)" 2>/dev/null; then echo "ERR: scaffold failed - react not present" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" || true; exit 21; fi

steps.name: dependencies - deterministic install and add shaka-player/serve if missing
steps.description: Install project dependencies deterministically (npm ci when package-lock.json exists, otherwise npm install). Ensure shaka-player is present (install if missing). Ensure a lightweight server (serve) is available for validation: prefer global or project deps/devDeps; only install as devDependency when not present. Prefer existing global jest or project-local jest; install jest as devDependency only if none present. Logs are written to /tmp/deps.log and failures surface concise logs.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/samsung-ott-sample-92971-93494/SamsungOTTSampleApplication"
cd "$WORKDIR"
LOG=/tmp/deps.log
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo "ERR: package.json missing" >&2; exit 30; fi
# Reproducible install when lockfile exists
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund > "$LOG" 2>&1 || (sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 31); else npm install --no-audit --no-fund > "$LOG" 2>&1 || (sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 32); fi
# Helper to check presence in deps/devDeps
has_pkg() { node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['$1'])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['$1'])) process.exit(0); else process.exit(1)" 2>/dev/null; }
# shaka-player
if ! has_pkg "shaka-player"; then npm install --no-audit --no-fund shaka-player --save >> "$LOG" 2>&1 || (sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 33); fi
# serve: prefer global, then project deps/devDeps, else install as devDependency
if ! command -v serve >/dev/null; then if ! has_pkg "serve"; then npm install --no-audit --no-fund --save-dev serve >> "$LOG" 2>&1 || (sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 34); fi; fi
# jest: prefer global or project-local, otherwise install devDependency
if ! command -v jest >/dev/null && [ ! -f node_modules/.bin/jest ]; then npm install --no-audit --no-fund --save-dev jest >> "$LOG" 2>&1 || (sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 35); fi

steps.name: testing - add minimal jest smoke test and run once (preserve permissions)
steps.description: Create a minimal Jest smoke test. Atomically add a test script to package.json only if missing while preserving ownership and mode. Run tests using project-local jest when present, otherwise use npx with explicit non-interactive flags. Logs to /tmp/test.log.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/samsung-ott-sample-92971-93494/SamsungOTTSampleApplication"
cd "$WORKDIR"
LOG=/tmp/test.log
mkdir -p src/__tests__
cat > src/__tests__/smoke.test.js <<'EOF'
describe('smoke', ()=>{it('basic', ()=>{expect(1).toBe(1)})})
EOF
# Preserve package.json ownership/mode when editing
if [ -f package.json ]; then MODE=$(stat -c %a package.json) UID=$(stat -c %u package.json) GID=$(stat -c %g package.json); else MODE=644; UID=$(id -u); GID=$(id -g); fi
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));p.scripts=p.scripts||{}; if(!p.scripts.test){p.scripts.test='jest --passWithNoTests'}; fs.writeFileSync('package.json.tmp',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)); fs.renameSync('package.json.tmp','package.json');"
# restore ownership/mode
chmod "$MODE" package.json || true
chown "$UID":"$GID" package.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
# Run tests: prefer local jest
if [ -f node_modules/.bin/jest ]; then CI=true ./node_modules/.bin/jest --passWithNoTests --colors=never > "$LOG" 2>&1 || (sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 40); else CI=true npx --yes --no-install jest --passWithNoTests > "$LOG" 2>&1 || (sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 41); fi

steps.name: start - start lightweight server to serve build output
steps.description: Start a lightweight HTTP server to serve the build output. Mirrors the server selection logic used by validation: prefer project-local serve, then global serve, else python3. Starts server in its own session leader and prints the PID for external lifecycle control. This provides a dedicated 'start' phase for CI tooling.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/samsung-ott-sample-92971-93494/SamsungOTTSampleApplication"
cd "$WORKDIR"
LOG=/tmp/start.log
PORT=${PORT:-5000}
# choose server
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then CMD=("./node_modules/.bin/serve" "-s" "build" "-l" "$PORT");
elif command -v serve >/dev/null; then CMD=("serve" "-s" "build" "-l" "$PORT");
elif command -v python3 >/dev/null; then CMD=("python3" "-m" "http.server" "$PORT" "--directory" "build");
else echo "ERR: no suitable server (serve or python3) found" >&2; exit 60; fi
# start in its own session leader and capture PID
setsid bash -c "exec \"${CMD[@]}\"" > "$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
# write pid to file for cleanup
echo "$PID" > /tmp/samsung_ott_sample_server.pid
echo "$PID"

steps.name: validation - serve production build, probe, and cleanup
steps.description: Start the lightweight server (same selection as start), probe the local URL for HTTP 200 with retries (30s timeout), then cleanly stop the server by killing the recorded session leader PID and children. Captures server logs and returns them on failure. Provides clear exit codes and evidence of success (http status and sample HTML head).
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/samsung-ott-sample-92971-93494/SamsungOTTSampleApplication"
cd "$WORKDIR"
LOG=/tmp/serve.log
PORT=5000
# choose server
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then CMD=("./node_modules/.bin/serve" "-s" "build" "-l" "$PORT");
elif command -v serve >/dev/null; then CMD=("serve" "-s" "build" "-l" "$PORT");
elif command -v python3 >/dev/null; then CMD=("python3" "-m" "http.server" "$PORT" "--directory" "build");
else echo "ERR: no suitable server (serve or python3) found" >&2; exit 60; fi
# start server in new session leader and capture PID reliably
setsid bash -c "exec \"${CMD[@]}\"" > "$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
# allow bind
sleep 1
# wait for readiness up to 30s
STATUS=000
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/ || echo "000")
  if [ "$STATUS" = "200" ]; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "http_status:$STATUS"
# cleanup: kill session leader and its children
if ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pkill -P "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sleep 1
  kill -KILL "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ "$STATUS" != "200" ]; then echo "Validation failed: http status $STATUS" >&2; echo "serve log:"; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" || true; exit 61; fi
# show small evidence
echo "ok: http_status=$STATUS"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/ | sed -n '1,20p'
